newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - Sept 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - Sept 6.

text.p: CHINA TIMES - The cabinet reviews typhoon damage. Government officials may be punished for inadequate supervision of relief work.
The cabinet approves draft legislation cracking down on crime gangs.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Two local officials sail to disputed Diaoyu islands. They plan to sail to the islands again with Hong Kong lawmakers on October 25.
Parliament opens new session today but Premier Lien Chan will not deliver a speech until September 24.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Sixty-seven legislators form a committee to speed up reviews on bills related to finance and economy.
August consumer prices rise 5.05 percent from a year earlier, the biggest rise since February last year.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - The government prepares T$40 billion in loans for the development of special industrial and commercial zones.
